cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful promotion. Come to the head of the table; I'll lead the toast. Such beautiful timing with the director's retirement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I worked for this. It wasn't just timing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Your patience has been splendidly rewarded by someone finally leaving you a chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you just be happy for me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Delighted. Take the chair while I raise my glass. I look forward to seeing what you do with the opportunity the rest of us were still waiting to be offered.

reason: Keep A as self-appointed toast leader who directs B new place, preserving warm words at every turn while resentment intensifies through the shared waiting group.
